messages:
Ravi (SupplyOps): FYI carrier flagged 2 boxes as DOA on H200 return batch. They're proposing to consolidate with next week's outbound to cut RMA fees. Need quick decision: consolidate vs ship separate.
Marisol (Logistics): Which boxes? Can you post AWBs and weights? Consolidation reduces per-package brokerage but adds transit handling.
Ravi (SupplyOps): AWBs:
```
AWB: SF-2026-9981 (22kg)
AWB: SF-2026-9982 (25kg)
Consolidate into MAWB: SF-MAWB-3344?
Carrier ETA for consolidation: 2026-04-06
```
Tobias (Infra): Note these are earmarked for ap-south-1 spare pool. If consolidation delays >48h we risk scheduling hot-swap deployments for two clusters. Thermal tolerance is ~48h under active monitoring.
Priya (Procurement): What's the declared value for insurance? Vendor suggests $180k total. We usually list actual invoice value. Also ask vendor for a brokerage credit; could be their logistic error.
Marisol (Logistics): Carrier quote: consolidation brokerage $300 vs $1,050 separate. Insurance sublimit they asked for is $200k. If we accept lower declared value we risk under-insured claim in case of transit damage.
Ravi (SupplyOps): ops-bot created case RMA-7712. Labels pending. Link: https://redwood.internal/rma/RMA-7712
ops-bot: RMA-7712 created by SupplyOps. Please attach photos and PO.
Priya (Procurement): I'll push vendor for full invoice backing and try to secure a $500 brokerage credit. If vendor declines, we still save by consolidating.
Tobias (Infra): Contingency: I can pull 1 unit from eu spare via crossdock into ap-south to cover immediate demand. That adds ~6h of transfer prep but avoids capacity blip. Anyone ok with that?
Marisol (Logistics): Crossdock approved if procurement signs off on transfer cost. Routing note: DE->IN crossdock requires temporary export doc.
Priya (Procurement): Approve temporary transfer. Record vendor credit expectations in the PO amendment. I'll log it under PO-4553-AMD1.
Ravi (SupplyOps): Action items:
- Marisol: confirm consolidation MAWB and final brokerage (ETA EOD).
- Priya: secure invoice backing/vendor credit and confirm declared value.
- Tobias: prep crossdock routing if delay >36h.
Marisol (Logistics): Request sent to SkyFreight to expedite manifest and provide consolidated house manifest for customs clearance.
Ravi (SupplyOps): Also check customs HS classification: vendor proposes 8542.33.10 — Ops please confirm.
Tobias (Infra): HS check done: 8542 may trigger electronics duties depending on destination. Use expedited lane if customs flags. I'll set up monitoring on the cluster health dashboards to alert on spare depletion.
Priya (Procurement): Vendor replied: "We accept consolidation; will credit $400 brokerage if documentation issue found." I'll try to get it to $700.
Marisol (Logistics): Manifest uploaded to RMA-7712: https://files.redwood/rma/7712/manifest_v2.zip
ops-bot: RMA-7712 manifest received. Labels generated: RMA-7712-LBL-01..02
Ravi (SupplyOps): Thanks team. If Marisol confirms brokerage < $500 we go ahead with consolidation. Tobias, hold crossdock as T2 contingency.
Marisol (Logistics): Confirmed: final brokerage if consolidated = $320. Proceeding now. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Procurement): I'll finalize PO amendment and log vendor credit expectation.
Tobias (Infra): Monitoring in place. Will alert oncall and queue spare swap if threshold crossed.
Ravi (SupplyOps): Closing loop — tracking in INC-2026-102. Ping here for any paperwork requests.
